name: Unit sequence starting relay
summary: Starts the next unit or operating step when the documented sequence condition is met.
description: Starts the next unit or operating step when the documented sequence condition is met.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the preceding unit status and sequence permissives. The associated drawing should trace the next unit's starting circuit; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the preceding unit status and sequence permissives.
Trace the next unit's starting circuit.
drawingChecklist: Label the preceding unit status and sequence permissives.
Cross-reference the next unit's starting circuit.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: A unit sequence starting relay advances a defined sequence; it does not identify the entire master sequencer.
